Question 5
?

Which of the following is equivalent to ∫Cxydy, where C is the path along a circle of radius 4, traversed from the point (4,0) to the point (−4,0), as shown above?

Hint: Use the parametrization r(t)=⟨4cos⁡t,4sin⁡t⟩.

a
 4∫0πsin2⁡tcos⁡tdt
b
64∫0π(sin⁡t+cos⁡t)dt
c
16∫0π(sin⁡t+cos2⁡t)dt
d
64∫0πsin⁡tcos2⁡tdt
e
 32∫0πsin⁡tcos⁡tdt
